entries.licence: Shipped product site; study the principle, do not copy its layout, copy or brand marks.
entries.not_to_copy: Stripe's logo, brand purple-blue, copy, product screenshots or exact page composition.
entries.pattern: Proof before pitch: real product interface and numbers early, before marketing claims.
entries.principle: When trust is the objection, show the working product and real proof first.
entries.why_it_works: The visitor's real objection is 'will this work for me?' — the live product answers it before any claim is made.

entries.licence: Shipped product site; study the principle, do not copy its layout, copy or brand marks.
entries.not_to_copy: Linear's logo, dark theme treatment, copy or exact hero composition.
entries.pattern: One idea, executed with restraint: a single product visual, quiet type, one accent.
entries.principle: Boldness spent in one place beats decoration spread everywhere.
entries.why_it_works: A single committed visual decision carries the whole page; nothing competes with it.

entries.licence: Shipped product site; study the principle, do not copy its layout, copy or brand marks.
entries.not_to_copy: Vercel's logo, triangle mark, copy or exact composition.
entries.pattern: The product is the demo: the hero shows the tool doing its job.
entries.principle: Hero opens with the most characteristic thing the product does.
entries.why_it_works: A live demo is proof and personality at once; it cannot be faked with a gradient.

entries.licence: Shipped product site; study the principle, do not copy its imagery, copy or brand marks.
entries.not_to_copy: Apple's photography, product renders, copy or exact page structure.
entries.pattern: One product per screen, full-bleed imagery, almost no chrome.
entries.principle: When the product is beautiful, the page gets out of the way.
entries.why_it_works: Restraint only works when the subject is strong. The page trusts the product.

entries.licence: Shipped product site; study the principle, do not copy its layout, copy or brand marks.
entries.not_to_copy: Notion's illustrations, copy, templates or exact section order.
entries.pattern: Editorial layout with real product screenshots inside the story, not as decoration.
entries.principle: Show the product inside the user's story, not on a pedestal.
entries.why_it_works: Real screenshots inside real workflows prove the product fits a working day.

entries.licence: Shipped app; study the motion principle, do not copy its characters, copy or screens.
entries.not_to_copy: Duolingo's owl, characters, sounds, copy or screen layouts.
entries.pattern: Motion that communicates state: a correct answer celebrates, a mistake corrects, a streak settles.
entries.principle: Motion with a job: trigger, move, settle — never decoration.
entries.why_it_works: Every animation answers a user question: did I get it right, what happens next?

entries.licence: Shipped app; study the flow principle, do not copy its screens, copy or brand marks.
entries.not_to_copy: Airbnb's screens, copy, photography or exact flow steps.
entries.pattern: Onboarding that asks one thing at a time and shows progress honestly.
entries.principle: A flow is a conversation, not a form.
entries.source_name: Airbnb (shipped app; flows on Mobbin free tier)
entries.why_it_works: One question per step lowers the cost of continuing; progress is visible, never faked.

entries.licence: Shipped app; study the state principle, do not copy its screens or brand marks.
entries.not_to_copy: Revolut's screens, copy, card designs or exact flows.
entries.pattern: Every money state designed: empty, loading, error, success — each with a clear next action.
entries.principle: States are the design: the empty state is where trust is won or lost.
entries.why_it_works: Money is anxiety. A designed empty state tells the user exactly what to do next.

entries.licence: Studio case studies; study the idea, do not copy any mark, logo or artwork.
entries.not_to_copy: Any Pentagram mark, logo, artwork or case-study imagery.
entries.pattern: The identity comes from the subject: one idea, built from the client's own material.
entries.principle: Design from the subject — the mark is the last decision, not the first.
entries.why_it_works: A mark that could only belong to this client cannot look generic.

entries.licence: Studio case studies; study the idea, do not copy any mark, logo or artwork.
entries.not_to_copy: Any Collins mark, logo, artwork or case-study imagery.
entries.pattern: Voice first: three words for the brand, then palette, type and imagery follow.
entries.principle: A brand is a voice with a visual system, not a logo with extras.
entries.why_it_works: When the voice is specific, every visual choice has a reason — and the system stays consistent.

entries.licence: Studio case studies; study the motion idea, do not copy any artwork, characters or frames.
entries.not_to_copy: Any Buck artwork, characters, frames or client work.
entries.pattern: One motion idea per film, executed with craft; the movement is the message.
entries.principle: Motion with a job, or no motion.
entries.why_it_works: A single motion idea, fully committed, is memorable; five half-ideas are noise.

entries.licence: Shipped social presence; study the principle, do not copy its artwork, posters or copy.
entries.not_to_copy: A24's posters, artwork, copy or exact post formats.
entries.pattern: The film's own world is the feed: stills, texture and tone from the work itself, not templates.
entries.principle: Social content comes from the subject's world, not from a template pack.
entries.source_name: A24 (social presence; discover via Behance / Awwwards)
entries.why_it_works: Content that could only come from this film cannot be mistaken for anyone else's.

entries.licence: Agency case studies; study the idea, do not copy any artwork, copy or campaign assets.
entries.not_to_copy: Any Wieden+Kennedy artwork, copy or campaign assets.
entries.pattern: One human truth, one line, one image — the campaign is the idea, not the media plan.
entries.principle: An ad is one promise, proved, with one action.
entries.why_it_works: A true observation about people survives every format; a slogan does not.

entries.licence: Gallery listings link to the original sites; the sites keep their own rights. Link out, do not re-host.
entries.not_to_copy: Any listed site's design, imagery or copy.
entries.pattern: Browse by category and tag; collect 5+ sources and extract the principle from each, not the look.
entries.principle: Research is a circuit, not a single search: award lists, galleries, systems, people.
entries.why_it_works: Hand-picked shipped sites, searchable by type — the fastest free research circuit.

entries.licence: Gallery listings link to the original sites; the sites keep their own rights. Link out, do not re-host.
entries.not_to_copy: Any listed site's design, imagery or copy.
entries.pattern: One-page sites show the whole argument in one scroll — study how the argument is ordered.
entries.principle: A page is an argument in order: hook, proof, offer, action.
entries.source_name: One Page Love (free gallery + free MCP, beta)
entries.why_it_works: Single-page sites make the structure visible: you can see the whole argument at once.

entries.licence: Sections measured from live pages; the pages keep their own rights. Link out, do not re-host.
entries.not_to_copy: Any measured section's design, fonts or colours as a copy.
entries.pattern: Sections with fonts and colours measured from the live page — study the mechanism, not the screenshot.
entries.principle: Extract the mechanism (type scale, colour roles, grid), not the picture.
entries.why_it_works: Measured tokens turn inspiration into something you can actually build from.

entries.licence: Award listings link to the original sites; the sites keep their own rights. Link out, do not scrape.
entries.not_to_copy: Any listed site's design, imagery or copy.
entries.pattern: Sites of the Day are a jury-curated top list. Filter by category and tag for the niche.
entries.principle: Award lists are the 'top 100' shortcut — curated, dated, and judged.
entries.source_name: Awwwards — Sites of the Day (free to browse)
entries.why_it_works: A jury has already done the filtering; your job is to extract principles from the winners.

entries.licence: MIT — components are free to ship. Attribution appreciated.
entries.not_to_copy: Nothing to avoid: MIT-licensed. Do not claim the components as your own design work.
entries.pattern: Copy-paste components with tokens: the system is the design, the page is an assembly.
entries.principle: A good component system makes consistency the default, not the effort.
entries.why_it_works: Tokens + components + states, already built and accessible — the fastest honest starting point for UI.

entries.licence: Gallery listings link to the original sites; the sites keep their own rights. Link out, do not re-host.
entries.not_to_copy: Any listed site's design, imagery or copy.
entries.pattern: Hand-picked web, app, motion and branding, curated since 2021.
entries.principle: Curation is a filter: a small good list beats a large unfiltered one.
entries.why_it_works: One curator's consistent taste is a faster teacher than an endless feed.

entries.licence: Designers keep their rights. Study case studies; never reuse artwork, copy or layouts.
entries.not_to_copy: Any portfolio artwork, copy, photography or layout.
entries.pattern: Full case studies show the reasoning, not just the final shot — read the process, not the thumbnail.
entries.principle: A case study teaches the decision; a shot only shows the result.
entries.source_name: Behance (free to browse; no working public browse API)
entries.why_it_works: Case studies expose the brief, the constraints and the rejected routes — the parts a single image hides.

entries.licence: Designers keep their rights. Shots are concepts, not shipped proof — label them as concepts.
entries.not_to_copy: Any shot's artwork, copy or layout.
entries.pattern: Single-screen shots are useful for direction and craft detail — and misleading as proof of a working product.
entries.principle: Concepts inspire direction; shipped work proves patterns. Never confuse the two.
entries.source_name: Dribbble (free to browse; v2 API is owner-scoped, no public browse API)
entries.why_it_works: Fast direction-finding, as long as you remember a shot is a poster, not a product.

entries.licence: Gallery listings link to the original sites; the sites keep their own rights. Free tier limited; Pro paid. Link out.
entries.not_to_copy: Any listed site's design, imagery or copy.
entries.pattern: Hand-picked sites with full-page screenshots, sections, mobile views and motion.
entries.principle: See the whole page and the mobile version before judging a design.
entries.why_it_works: Full-page and mobile views stop you from copying a desktop hero that fails on a phone.

entries.licence: Recordings belong to their apps; breakdowns belong to 60fps. Free to browse; MCP is paid. Link out.
entries.not_to_copy: Any recording, storyboard artwork or SwiftUI code as a copy.
entries.pattern: Motion broken down as trigger, start, move, settle — with timing and easing named.
entries.principle: Good motion is a sentence with a beginning, a middle and an end.
entries.why_it_works: Named timing and easing turn 'nice animation' into something you can actually build.

note: Text-only digests, written in our own words. Every entry links out to a public source; no images, screenshots, copy, logos or layouts are re-hosted. Shipped-product entries are principles observed from public sites, not endorsements and not the sites' own claims.
source: Research report §2 and §7; free galleries and shipped sites listed there.
